name: agentic-workflow-essentials
description: AWE — Cursor plugin for a phase-gated multi-agent pipeline (intake → ship). Install the plugin; optional setup.mjs still copies files into a repo for cloud agents.

scripts.check: node --check setup.mjs && for f in awe/scripts/*.mjs awe/scripts/lib/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; for (const p of ['.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json','awe/.cursor-plugin/plugin.json','awe/mcp.json','awe/hooks/hooks.json']) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));"
